applies_why: The judge does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it calls Matthew 1:16 underdetermined and records that the relevant points were answered.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings; the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge treats Matthew 1:16 as underdetermined and says the relevant challenge was answered, it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness, which obeys K-G4.
